verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app, and the evidence documents no public API for driving it programmatically. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. Being open source, running the host via `swift run`, and installing through Homebrew are developer building blocks and distribution channels, not a documented API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
